sections.title: An Exact Strip Observable and the Half-Plane One-Arm Probability for Critical Bond Percolation on the Square Lattice
sections.abstract: The paper proves the half-plane one-arm exponent for critical Bernoulli bond percolation on the square lattice by deriving an exact strip observable and combining it with RSW, a finite local modification, and quasi-multiplicativity.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim P_1/2(A_1^+(r,R)) is asymptotic to (r/R)^(1/3) uniformly for 1<=r<R.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Critical Bernoulli bond percolation on the square lattice; half-plane one-arm event.
sections.caveat: v1 preprint; proof not independently assessed.

sections.title: Local Matrix Muckenhoupt Weights and Quantitative Weighted Inequalities Achieving Global Best Known Exponents
sections.abstract: The paper develops real-variable properties of local matrix Muckenhoupt weights and proves quantitative bounds for several local operators.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim sharp local maximal-operator bounds for p in (1,2] and local fractional-integral bounds matching global best-known exponents.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Local matrix weights and local matrix-weighted Lebesgue spaces, including Schrödinger-operator Riesz transforms.
sections.caveat: Sharpness is parameter- and operator-regime dependent.

sections.title: Ordered matchings versus triangles via pseudorandom triangle-free graphs
sections.abstract: For ordered multicolor Ramsey numbers, the paper improves a lower bound for random ordered matchings against triangles.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Random ordered matching with interval chromatic number two in ordered edge-colorings.
sections.caveat: Asymptotic result for the specified random matching model, not every matching.

sections.title: Asymptotic infinitesimal freeness of covariance matrices
sections.abstract: The paper derives a first-order 1/n expansion for mixed moments of covariance matrices and applies it to asymptotic and infinitesimal freeness.
sections.claimed_result: The authors claim explicit moment formulas and freeness under a fourth-moment condition.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Covariance matrices with independent centered complex entries of unit variance; fourth-moment condition for freeness.
sections.caveat: Conclusions depend on stated moment assumptions.

sections.title: Algebraically independent distances and rigid metrics
sections.abstract: The paper proves approximation and genericity results for metrics with algebraically independent distances and for rigid metrics.
sections.claimed_result: Such metrics are shown to be uniformly approximable or G_delta under the topological hypotheses stated in the abstract.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Compatible metrics on metrizable, Polish, locally compact Polish, and compact spaces under the specified hypotheses.
sections.caveat: Conclusions do not apply uniformly without the stated topological assumptions.
